comparison.objective: Reconnect a basin-stopper pivot rod through a captive eye and exercise the stopper; candidate fractures and removes insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve recessed alignment, but rod-through-eye insertion and linkage operation do not test hammer impact, notch fracture, or loose-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Verified rod engagement plus a complete opening/reseating cycle versus four fractures, four tray deposits, insert retention, and damage avoidance. No numeric engagement tolerances are given.
comparison.reason: This tests captive linkage assembly and function, not destructive finishing of inserts.
